HivelyTracker replayer (hvl_replay.c, hvl_tables.c, plus headers) by Pete Gordon, BSD 3-Clause (LICENSE). Plays AHX (THX)
and Hively (HVL) songs. Upstream: HivelyTracker by Pete Gordon (pete-gordon/hivelytracker), directory Replayer_MacOS, files
unchanged, taken 2026-11-10 from the DEViLBOX checkout's third-party/hivelytracker-master.
The replayer has no bounds checks against the file length; the adapter copies every song into a buffer padded with zeros
(HVL_PAD) so a header that claims more data than the file holds reads zeros, not foreign memory.
